options.means: a bar's `members: [{name, logo?, short?}]` (2-8, the page's `member_noun`): EQUAL tiles naming who is in its ONE value, the total written; a member with a value is refused (E99 s101)
a bar's `claim: {by, said, evidence, src, standing?, quote?}` (P73 T1): SOMEONE'S figure - outlined in its ink, quoted, the speaker credited over it; no computed label reads it unmarked
the claim's body: `outline` (default - measured furthest from a filled bar) or `hatch` (P73-HG)
true adds "no evidence attached" under a claim with evidence "none" and on the source line; off by default (the label credits the speaker)
a story page's `axes: "none"` (P71 T31, S5): no axis, gridline or framed plot, one zero rule; every value written, the bars from zero; refused beside left_gutter or an axis key
a bar's `pill: true` on an axis-less page: its label written in a capsule of the bar's own ink over its value and counting pill (BUB 0:48-1:12)
a bar's or a line series' `logo` (a catalogue id): the approved cutout under the bar, or heading the end tag (the name in the key); else dropped with a WARN (11-ARCHIVAL s4)

lives.note: buildLedger / builder "story" / "combo" (pick_builder); paintLedgerCombo for bars + a line

cards.title: The broken cross-era axis
cards.does: One line page across two eras on ONE x axis: the years between cut out and the cut drawn - a // on the axis, "2001 // 2021" written, each era named, one y, nothing drawn through the gap.
cards.when: the claim is that the eras' LEVELS are comparable (E99 s111); when the SHAPES match, the rebased overlay (years from each era's start) stays the form

author.key: series object (evidence/objects/*.series.json) "break": {"after", "before", "eras"} + "claim": "level" on a dense-line page (ledger:<series-id>:line)

phases.name: the cut stands
phases.does: axis, gridlines and rules stop at one era's last datum and resume at the next's first; the // on the axis, the gap written, each era named - with the axis, at every instant

phases.name: era by era
phases.does: under ;build=lines each era's series draws whole in turn; one series across both eras draws on one clock and lifts at the cut (a clip)

blends.source: Bravos HIS 7:18-8:01 (AI and Railway Spending As a % of GDP)
E99 s111 the broken cross-era axis

options.means: {after, before, eras}: the first era's last datum, the second's first, the eras' names; one dense line in one unit, no datum or tick between, 16:9
"level" is required beside a break; "shape" is refused, pointing to the rebased overlay (years from each era's start)

lives.note: buildLedgerLine: mx is lpBreakScale's when axes.break is set; ledger_page._validate_break / era_void_warning; build_scene_timeline_f.check_broken_axis

callable.why: implicit: a dense-line object that carries `break` + `claim: "level"` is this page (no plate token of its own)

cards.title: The schematic - a shape drawn with no data
cards.does: A line page drawn from a named closed form, not from data: a phase model (hype, waves, debt cycle) or an illustration (candles along a ghost wave, an axis-free motif); no value on the page, the tag 'a shape, not a series'.
cards.when: a phase model carrying the narrative, named as a model - 'the world's art carrying the narrative' (E99 s109 (1)); never with axis values, figures it cannot source, or without the mark that it is 'a shape, not a series'

author.key: series object (evidence/objects/*.series.json) "schematic": {"shape": "hype"|"waves"|"debt_cycle"|"candles"|"motif", "phases": [{"name", "from", "to", "side"?}], "n"?, "name"?, "color"?} IN PLACE OF "series" on a line page (ledger:<series-id>:line) - and inside it `overlay`: {"series": {"name"?, "pts", "src", "tier"?, "color"?}, "axis": {"unit", "label"}, "xticks"?, "at", "dur"?, "claim": {"at", "x", "text"}}

phases.name: the shape draws
phases.does: the generated curve draws on the line page's pen; the y axis a bare rule, no tick, no number, no end tag (the title names the shape)

phases.name: each phase named as the pen reaches it
phases.does: a phase's name fades in from its stretch's start to its middle - over the curve where it bows up, under where it bows down
phases.trigger: the pen's drawn x (the stroke's own dash)

phases.name: the candles print (candles)
phases.does: each candle (a wick high to low, a body open to close in the sign ink) fades in as the pen crosses its pitch, its body growing from the open, never ahead of the pen; the ghost under them is faded context
phases.trigger: the pen's drawn x (the stroke's own dash) - a build_to on the word moves it

phases.name: the measured series joins (overlay)
phases.does: on its word a real series draws over the standing shape on its OWN right axis (its data's range, its unit, its label, its ink) and its own dates (the plot gives up one tick row; the tag keeps its place); it blooms
phases.trigger: overlay.at, over overlay.dur (the page's pen law)

phases.name: the claim lands (overlay)
phases.does: a ring and a dot ON the shape at claim.x pop in (the datum badge's spring), then the claim's words off the mark at the s90 floor, 1-3 lines, a leader to the ring, in the measured series' ink

blends.source: E99 s109 (1) a schematic drawn with no data
blends.became: no value on the page, the tag, the digit refusal

blends.source: Bravos BUB 04:47.3 (candles over a ghost wave) and JPN 09:09-09:11 (the "Market" motif)
blends.became: the two illustrations: generated candles, the axis-free wave

blends.source: E99 s125 a real series laid over a schematic, on its own axis, where it sits a claim

options.means: {shape, phases, n?, name?, color?} in place of `series`, generated on x 0..1; data, a unit, a rule, a tick or a domain beside it refused; a digit in a bracket/figure/note/span needs its `src`
T8 (USE-WHEN :571, rarely; price action as illustration): 30 candles generated along a ghost wave, green up / red down, no value; phases optional, a `color` refused
T46 (USE-WHEN :989, the close strips the chart to a symbol): an axis-free rising wave, its 8 turning points a `datum_badge` names by `vertex`; a `ylabel` refused; the title names it
E99 s125 (P71 T39): a sourced series on its OWN right axis (unit + label) and dates, on its word; a fit key refused (s125 (2)); a claim's words required (s125 (4)); golden schematic-meets-the-data

cards.when: the sentence is what a total is MADE OF (paid by revenue vs borrowed; what capex took vs what was left) - s109's honesty tests: every part true to its value, every figure and the total written (E99 s110 (1), s100)

author.key: series object bar datum "segments": [{"name", "value", "value_string"?, "color"?}] (2-4) on a bars page (ledger:<series-id>:bars); the bar's own "value" is the total

phases.name: the stack grows with its bar
phases.does: each part mirrors its bar every frame (grow, fade, drain, park) - one clock, the bars law's

phases.name: the figures and the key land
phases.does: each part's figure (inside, shrunk to FIG_MIN, else on a leader) and the key land as the bar's value does (0.9-1.0 of its grow)

blends.source: E99 s110 (1) a stack of values

blends.became: the parts true to their values, the figures written

cards.title: The bar-chart race ledger page
cards.does: Ranked bars race across periods on the ledger page.

phases.name: grow in
phases.does: bars grow into period 0

phases.name: periods
phases.does: the race steps period by period, rows swapping at crossings

options.means: The row's `;path=eased|clothoid` names which way a mark travels between two period knots. Both ship (E91 s1); the knots and the period clock are identical in either.
path=eased, THE DEFAULT: the engine as it is - the value smoothstepped, the rank sliding through its swap window. The operator: smoother.
path=clothoid: the same knots on the same clock fitted as clothoid segments (kinetics/clothoid.mjs) - the mark turns where the eased path corners. The operator: more energy.

cards.title: The share ledger page (the pie, the donut, the 3D pie)
cards.does: A part-to-whole pie, one slice highlighted: the P48 T4 pie, or a donut, a tilted extruded pie, a slice exploded - every angle true, every figure written. Past five slices it is a page REPORTED with its numbers (E99 s100, s106).

phases.name: sweep
phases.does: the pie sweeps round

phases.name: names write
phases.does: each slice's name writes as its slice completes

options.means: a DONUT: the hole as a share of the radius, (0, 0.75]; every slice's figure is written on it
true or {tilt 10-60 deg (50), depth 0.02-0.3 of R (0.12), hatch}: a 2.5D projection of the TRUE-ANGLE slices, sides lit by the one stage light
true or {index (the claim's slice), out 0.04-0.3 of R (0.14)}: that slice leaves the whole on the `explode` species' word

cards.title: A part-to-whole routed to the page that draws it
cards.does: Not a bars or line page: ledger_page routes a `shares` object to --variant share (a pie or a donut) or --variant treemap, where its honesty is checked - never refused as a type (E99 s100).

author.key: a ledger id naming a series whose values are shares (a donut)

callable.why: UNCHARTABLE: 'shares' is a part-to-whole - a pie, a donut or a treemap - and this variant draws bars or lines, which the file does not carry: draw it as --variant share or --variant treemap (E99 s100)

cards.title: The dated event timeline ledger page
cards.does: Dated events on one date axis, no series: an empty stretch CUT and drawn `//` with its length, each stretch writing its tick (E28), today marked; events land on their words, the newest lit; a moved date struck.

author.key: ledger plate id  ledger:<series-id>:timeline[:<emphasize>[:<quiet_zone>[:<enter>[:<exit>]]]]; each word a `build_to` with target {kind: datum, index: <event>}

phases.name: axis draws
phases.does: the axis draws stretch by stretch; ticks, the cut's // and its length, and today appear as the pen passes; each stretch's rule writes

phases.name: event lands
phases.does: the pin pops, its leader draws, its date and label write; events one word lands arrive in turn
phases.trigger: a build_to naming the event (or, with none on the row, in turn over the build)

phases.name: light
phases.does: the newest named event glows and takes the lit ink; the one before hands its light over

phases.name: moved date
phases.does: the old date is struck, the axis lights from it to the new date, and the new one lands and takes the light
phases.trigger: the second build_to naming the moved event (else MOVE_AFTER after it lands)
